whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Lee Martial Arts & Play Zone,

I noticed your martial arts and play center has stellar 4.9★ reviews across 155+ ratings in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile website for class inquiries and kids' play zone bookings.

Maine aapke center ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, martial arts batch timings, aur play zone highlights integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/leemartialplay

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Lee Martial Arts & Play Zone team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and mobile-first speed for your Malahi Pakri location in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact class timings aur actual photos setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
